summary: Built M4-S04 (docs). package.xml is the build-level manifest: 23 types, 38 explicit members, API 62.0, no wildcards. It is the union of the eleven step manifests plus M3-S03's five ApexClass members and M3-S04's LightningComponentBundle, and it includes M2-S04's rule exactly once, as amended test 5 requires, although the step's inputs still call M2-S04 excluded. A two-way self-check over the whole artefacts tree is consistent, and the set matches the 44 components the org validated in MOCK-DEPLOY-M4 run 3. deploy-order.md is the cross-milestone order and cutover runbook. It splits the deploy into request 1 (36 members) and request 2 (the Report and Dashboard), as N4-F-06 requires, with the column codes and the runningUser handled between the halves. It lists four deploy-copy edits: the OpportunityStage merge, the related list, a new retrieve-and-merge of the Opportunity object file (object-creation-and-design Gotcha 10), and the runningUser. It also gives 17 pre-deploy checks with owners, 10 post-deploy steps, the four UAT negative cases, and 11 things the validate-only loop could not prove. The only command that validates anything is scripts/mock_deploy.py. Declared checker exit 0 (also --strict); XML parses; check-outputs ok. Outcome: built.
confidence_rationale: Step 10 MEDIUM. Every member is traced to a step manifest or file; the declared checker exited 0 on the first pass; check-outputs is ok; exactly the two declared outputs were written. HIGH fails because several Questions-to-Ask rows rest on documented defaults (A4, A34, the skill's production rollbackOnError rule) or are left to the release owner (test level), and because the runbook's key claims (E3's effect, the P-8 stage behaviour, the SMB page) are UNVERIFIED and only an org can settle them.

process_observations.observation: All eleven step manifests name members explicitly at one API version (62.0), so the build-level manifest is a pure union plus the six Apex and LWC members, and that union equals the 44 components the org validated in MOCK-DEPLOY-M4 run 3.

Each step's deploy-order note already named its own retrieve-and-merge and post-deploy item (A24, A26, A29, A32, A34, D-M4S01-01), so the cutover runbook aggregates recorded facts instead of discovering them at the end.

M3-S05 ships a two-element Opportunity.object-meta.xml and its header says deploying it 'changes no other Opportunity configuration'. admin/object-creation-and-design Gotcha 10 says a partial object file replaces the whole object definition. MOCK-DEPLOY-M3 run 4 only showed that it deploys. The runbook makes a retrieve-and-merge (E3) a blocking pre-deploy step and marks the effect UNVERIFIED.

Q8 answers that the ~140-deal reassignment needs no field mapping, but none of the generic pipeline's open stages exists in Enterprise_Sales_Process, and admin/record-types-and-page-layouts Gotcha 1 says such values are cleared on a record-type change. A stage mapping then fires M2-S04's ISCHANGED(StageName) product rule for about 20 deals without products (Q16) unless the bypass holder runs it, which in turn invokes Q17's Chatter control.

The org-default record page has no record-type dimension (D-M3S05-01), so SMB records also open the Enterprise page, and the discount panel on it has no record-type gate. The plan recorded the Renewal consequence; the SMB one is implied but unstated against requirement item 6.
